1.w: And it came to pass when mankind began to multiply on the face of the ground and daughters were born to them,

2.w: that the sons of God saw the daughters of mankind, and they [were] good. And they took for themselves wives from all that they chose.

3.w: And YHWH said, “My Spirit shall not strive with mankind forever, for indeed he [is] flesh. And his days shall be a hundred and twenty years.”

4.w: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also after that, when the sons of God came in to the daughters of mankind, and they bore [children] to them. Those [were] the mighty men who [were] from of old, men of the name.

5.w: And YHWH saw that the wickedness of mankind on the earth [was] great and [that] every inclination of the thoughts of his heart [was] only evil all the day.

6.w: And YHWH regretted that He had made mankind on the earth, and He was grieved in His heart.

7.w: And YHWH said, “I will wipe out mankind whom I have created from the face of the ground—from mankind to beast, to crawling thing, to the bird of the heavens—for I regret that I have made them!”

8.w: And Noah found favor in the eyes of YHWH.

9.w: These [are] the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generations; Noah walked with God.

10.w: And Noah begat three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

11.w: And the earth was corrupt before the face of God, and the earth was filled [with] violence.

12.w: And God saw the earth, and behold, it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

13.w: And God said to Noah, “The end of all flesh has come before My face, for the earth is filled [with] violence from their faces. And behold, I am destroying them [along] with the earth!

14.w: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; you shall make rooms in the ark and you shall cover it inside and outside with a covering.

15.w: And this [is] how you shall make it: Three hundred cubits [is] the length of the ark, fifty cubits its width, and thirty cubits its height.

16.w: You shall make a window for the ark, and you shall finish it to a cubit from above, and you shall set the door of the ark in its side. [With] lower, second, and third [decks] you shall make it.

17.w: And I—behold, I, am bringing the flood of waters on the earth, to destroy all flesh that [has] in it the breath of life from under the heavens. Everything that [is] on the earth shall perish!

18.w: And I will establish My covenant with you, and you shall go into the ark—you and your sons and your wife and the wives of your sons with you.

19.w: And from every living thing, from all flesh, two of every [kind] you shall bring into the ark to keep [them] alive with you; male and female they shall be.

20.w: And from the bird according to its kind, [and] the animal according to its kind, [and] from every crawling thing of the ground according to its kind, two of every [kind] shall come to you to be kept alive.

21.w: And you shall take for yourself from all food that is eaten, and you shall gather [it] to yourself, and it shall be for you and for them for food.”

22.w: And Noah did according to all that God had commanded him; so he did.
